name: StockLevelMonitor
tagline: Stock Level Monitor turns a list of stock items into a replenishment board.
description: Stock Level Monitor turns a list of stock items into a replenishment board. For every item it compares the quantity on hand with the reorder point, the maximum level and the average daily usage, and gives it a clear status: Out of stock, Below reorder point, Low cover, Healthy, Overstock or No stock data.
features: Status rules (out of stock, below reorder point, low days of cover, overstock)
Stock bars with reorder and max markers
Suggested order quantities rounded to pack size
A reorder list with quantity validation and outputs for canvas Patch or flows
Cards or table layout and a phone card view
